title: VDBE saved SQL ownership and reprepare bytecode swap

scope.rationale: sqlite3VdbeSetSql owns the saved SQL copy and preparation metadata; sqlite3VdbeSwap exchanges a recompiled VDBE body while deliberately restoring handle list links and saved SQL identity, then propagating preparation/counter state to the persistent statement. These are one reprepare ownership boundary.
excluded_responsibilities: SQL normalization/double-quoted-string list disabled in pinned profile

external_source_responsibilities: Caller provides two VDBEs on the same connection and owns reprepare ordering
dependencies.caller_closure: Complete active SetSql and Swap behavior plus saved SQL/preparation/counter fields are assigned. Higher-level schema-reprepare orchestration and teardown remain follow-on units.

inputs: nullable Vdbe plus SQL bytes/length/preparation flags
two same-db Vdbe objects, where A is recompiled body and B persistent handle
outputs: connection-owned N-byte SQL duplicate and metadata; exchanged Vdbe bodies with list links/SQL restored and B reprepare state updated
contracts.ownership: SetSql allocates zSql through the connection; Vdbe owns it. Swap moves all body owners, then swaps links and zSql back so handle/list identity remains stable. Old B body moves to A for cleanup.
contracts.state_and_results: Without SAVESQL, SetSql clears expmask before fallible duplication. Swap makes B expmask/prepFlags/aCounter equal post-swap A and increments B REPREPARE counter.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds connection mutex. No callback or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Null SetSql is a no-op. SQL duplication OOM leaves zSql null but prepFlags/expmask updated and sticky connection OOM. Swap itself cannot fail.

representation_differences: C whole-struct assignment and explicit temporary pointers map to Zig extern-struct assignment and typed swaps with identical field order.
Pinned profile omits zNormSql swap because SQLITE_ENABLE_NORMALIZE is disabled.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker exercises null SetSql, forced SQL-duplicate OOM, normal distinct SQL owners, operation bodies, expmask/prepFlags/counters, and a two-node connection list before Swap. C and Zig compare all post-swap body/handle/link/Parse relationships in a 366-observation trace.
oracle.normalization: SQL contents, fields, counters and link/owner relationships are exact; allocation addresses are ignored.

assurance.oom: Deterministic SQL duplicate allocation failure preserves metadata and null ownership; later cases clean all saved SQL exactly once.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O/callback; caller mutex remains orchestration obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: Source asserts same connection and first zSql assignment; tests satisfy both and use exact linked VDBEs.
assurance.continuation: Post-swap persistent B owns recompiled body and A owns old body for cleanup; both are deleted through their stable connection links.
assurance.performance: One SQL duplicate; Swap uses fixed-size structure/pointer/counter copies without allocation.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact linked Vdbe/Parse/Sqlite3 owners. Production schema-reprepare path remains handwritten/unmigrated.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Integrate production reprepare and P4-aware teardown.

independent_review.notes: Requires production reprepare integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect production schema-reprepare orchestration to source VDBE owners.
Port P4-aware destruction for both swapped bodies.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeaux.c:55-82 was reviewed completely for SetSql null handling, prepFlags/expmask ordering, zSql precondition, and connection duplication
upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeaux.c:115-153 was reviewed completely for whole-Vdbe swap followed by list-link/zSql restoration, metadata propagation, counter copy, and REPREPARE increment
upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeInt.h:490-525 was reviewed for prepFlags/aCounter/zSql/expmask and adjacent swapped ownership fields
prepare.c:780-815 and 895-920 caller context was inspected for saved-SQL and same-connection reprepare ordering; vdbe_aux.zig targets are AST-hashed
callers: sqlite3LockAndPrepare calls SetSql after successful parser/code generation when a VDBE exists
sqlite3Reprepare prepares a replacement statement, calls Swap(new,persistent), resets old/new ownership, and finalizes the temporary owner
Statement status, binding-expiration, expanded-SQL, and finalize paths consume zSql/expmask/counters after these transitions
callees: SetSql always records prepFlags, clears expmask unless SAVESQL, asserts first ownership, and calls sqlite3DbStrNDup for exactly n SQL bytes
Swap requires same db, exchanges all fields, then swaps pVNext/ppVPrev and zSql back so handle/list/SQL identity stays stable
Persistent B receives A expmask/prepFlags/counters after restoration and increments SQLITE_STMTSTATUS_REPREPARE; old B body remains on A for cleanup
SQL normalization fields are inactive in the pinned profile
assertions_branches_cleanup: Five behavior IDs cover null no-op, SAVESQL branch, first-zSql assertion, and same-db swap assertion
Duplication OOM leaves zSql null with metadata already updated and sticky connection OOM; Swap cannot allocate or fail
Every body owner moves exactly once while list and SQL owners remain attached to their original public handles
upstream_tests: upstream/sqlite/test/schema.test, errmsg.test, capi3.test, and reprepare-related pragma/auth tests exercise SQLITE_SCHEMA recompilation and persistent handles
Statement status and expanded-SQL tests observe REPREPARE counters, saved SQL, binding masks, and continuation
Project builder differential compares null/OOM SetSql, distinct SQL/body/list/Parse relationships, metadata/counters, REPREPARE increment, and exact cleanup ownership
